# Jaleel White, aka Urkel, returns in MNTN ad that asks: ‘Did AI Do That?’


The MNTN Team | 1 Min Read


[News](https://mountain.com/news/)[Press](https://mountain.com/press/)


Jaleel White and his famous catchphrase—ever so slightly altered—are front and center in a new MNTN campaign promoting updates to its QuickFrame[AI video creation](https://quickframe.com/blog/ai-video-generator/) platform, designed to help brands turn ideas into finished TV ads in a matter of minutes.
